001package com.streamconverter.examples;
002
003import com.streamconverter.StreamConverter;
004import com.streamconverter.command.IStreamCommand;
005import com.streamconverter.command.impl.csv.CsvNavigateCommand;
006import com.streamconverter.command.impl.json.JsonNavigateCommand;
007import com.streamconverter.command.rule.PassThroughRule;
008import com.streamconverter.path.CSVPath;
009import com.streamconverter.path.TreePath;
010import java.io.ByteArrayInputStream;
011import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
012import java.io.IOException;
013import java.io.InputStream;
014import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
015import org.slf4j.Logger;
016import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
017
018/**
019 * Performance optimization examples for StreamConverter.
020 *
021 * <p>This class demonstrates: - Memory-efficient processing techniques - Concurrent pipeline
022 * optimization - Large dataset handling - Performance monitoring
023 */
024public class PerformanceOptimizationExamples {
025
026  private static final Logger logger =
027      LoggerFactory.getLogger(PerformanceOptimizationExamples.class);
028
029  /**
030   * アプリケーションのエントリーポイント。パフォーマンス最適化の例を実行します。
031   *
032   * @param args コマンドライン引数（使用されません）
033   */
034  public static void main(String[] args) {
035    logger.info("⚡ StreamConverter - Performance Optimization Examples");
036    logger.info("=====================================================\n");
037
038    try {
039      // Example 1: Large dataset processing
040      largeDatasetProcessing();
041
042      // Example 2: Concurrent pipeline optimization
043      concurrentPipelineOptimization();
044
045      // Example 3: Memory-efficient processing
046      memoryEfficientProcessing();
047
048      // Example 4: Performance monitoring
049      performanceMonitoring();
050
051    } catch (Exception e) {
052      logger.error("Performance example failed: {}", e.getMessage(), e);
053    }
054  }
055
056  /** Example 1: Processing large datasets efficiently */
057  private static void largeDatasetProcessing() throws IOException {
058    logger.info("📊 Large Dataset Processing");
059    logger.info("============================");
060
061    // Generate large CSV dataset
062    StringBuilder largeDataset = new StringBuilder();
063    largeDataset.append("id,name,value,timestamp\n");
064
065    for (int i = 1; i <= 10000; i++) {
066      largeDataset.append(
067          String.format(
068              "%d,Item%d,%.2f,2023-07-15T%02d:%02d:%02d\n",
069              i, i, Math.random() * 1000, (i % 24), (i % 60), (i % 60)));
070    }
071
072    long startTime = System.currentTimeMillis();
073
074    // Process large dataset with memory-efficient navigation
075    logger.info("🔄 Processing 10,000 records...");
076    processDataWithTiming(
077        largeDataset.toString(),
078        CsvNavigateCommand.create(new CSVPath("name"), new PassThroughRule()));
079
080    long endTime = System.currentTimeMillis();
081    logger.info(String.format("⏱️ Processing completed in %d ms", endTime - startTime));
082
083    // Show memory usage
084    Runtime runtime = Runtime.getRuntime();
085    long memoryUsed = runtime.totalMemory() - runtime.freeMemory();
086    logger.info(String.format("💾 Memory used: %.2f MB", memoryUsed / (1024.0 * 1024.0)));
087
088    logger.info("\n" + "=".repeat(60) + "\n");
089  }
090
091  /** Example 2: Concurrent pipeline optimization */
092  private static void concurrentPipelineOptimization() throws IOException {
093    logger.info("🔗 Concurrent Pipeline Optimization");
094    logger.info("====================================");
095
096    String jsonData = generateLargeJsonData();
097
098    // Single command processing
099    long startTime = System.currentTimeMillis();
100    logger.info("🔄 Single command processing...");
101    processDataWithTiming(
102        jsonData, JsonNavigateCommand.create(TreePath.fromJson("$"), new PassThroughRule()));
103    long singleTime = System.currentTimeMillis() - startTime;
104
105    // Pipeline processing (demonstrates concurrent execution)
106    startTime = System.currentTimeMillis();
107    logger.info("\n🔄 Pipeline processing (concurrent)...");
108    IStreamCommand[] pipeline = {
109      JsonNavigateCommand.create(TreePath.fromJson("$"), new PassThroughRule()),
110      (IStreamCommand) (in, out) -> in.transferTo(out),
111      (IStreamCommand) (in, out) -> in.transferTo(out)
112    };
113    processDataWithTiming(jsonData, pipeline);
114    long pipelineTime = System.currentTimeMillis() - startTime;
115
116    logger.info(String.format("📈 Performance comparison:"));
117    logger.info(String.format("  Single command: %d ms", singleTime));
118    logger.info(String.format("  Pipeline: %d ms", pipelineTime));
119    logger.info(
120        String.format("  CPU cores utilized: %d", Runtime.getRuntime().availableProcessors()));
121
122    logger.info("\n" + "=".repeat(60) + "\n");
123  }
124
125  /** Example 3: Memory-efficient processing demonstration */
126  private static void memoryEfficientProcessing() throws IOException {
127    logger.info("💾 Memory-Efficient Processing");
128    logger.info("===============================");
129
130    // Generate data that would be problematic for memory
131    StringBuilder hugeDataset = new StringBuilder();
132    hugeDataset.append("id,data\n");
133
134    for (int i = 1; i <= 50000; i++) {
135      hugeDataset.append(String.format("%d,%s\n", i, "x".repeat(100))); // 100-char string per row
136    }
137
138    long beforeMemory = getUsedMemory();
139
140    logger.info("🔄 Processing 50,000 records with 100-char data each...");
141    processDataWithTiming(
142        hugeDataset.toString(),
143        CsvNavigateCommand.create(new CSVPath("id"), new PassThroughRule()));
144
145    long afterMemory = getUsedMemory();
146    long memoryIncrease = afterMemory - beforeMemory;
147
148    logger.info(String.format("💾 Memory increase: %.2f MB", memoryIncrease / (1024.0 * 1024.0)));
149    logger.info("✅ Demonstrates streaming processing with constant memory usage");
150
151    logger.info("\n" + "=".repeat(60) + "\n");
152  }
153
154  /** Example 4: Performance monitoring and optimization */
155  private static void performanceMonitoring() throws IOException {
156    logger.info("📊 Performance Monitoring");
157    logger.info("==========================");
158
159    String testData = generateTestData();
160
161    // Test different processing strategies
162    logger.info("🧪 Testing different processing strategies:\n");
163
164    // Strategy 1: Direct processing
165    long start = System.nanoTime();
166    processDataWithTiming(
167        testData, CsvNavigateCommand.create(new CSVPath("name"), new PassThroughRule()));
168    long directTime = System.nanoTime() - start;
169
170    // Strategy 2: Pipeline processing
171    start = System.nanoTime();
172    IStreamCommand[] pipeline = {
173      CsvNavigateCommand.create(new CSVPath("name"), new PassThroughRule()),
174      (IStreamCommand) (in, out) -> in.transferTo(out)
175    };
176    processDataWithTiming(testData, pipeline);
177    long pipelineTime = System.nanoTime() - start;
178
179    // Strategy 3: Multi-stage processing
180    start = System.nanoTime();
181    IStreamCommand[] multiStage = {
182      CsvNavigateCommand.create(new CSVPath("name"), new PassThroughRule()),
183      (IStreamCommand) (in, out) -> in.transferTo(out),
184      (IStreamCommand) (in, out) -> in.transferTo(out),
185      (IStreamCommand) (in, out) -> in.transferTo(out)
186    };
187    processDataWithTiming(testData, multiStage);
188    long multiStageTime = System.nanoTime() - start;
189
190    // Performance analysis
191    logger.info("\n📈 Performance Analysis:");
192    logger.info(String.format("  Direct processing: %.2f ms", directTime / 1_000_000.0));
193    logger.info(String.format("  Pipeline processing: %.2f ms", pipelineTime / 1_000_000.0));
194    logger.info(String.format("  Multi-stage processing: %.2f ms", multiStageTime / 1_000_000.0));
195
196    double throughput = (testData.length() * 1000.0) / (directTime / 1_000_000.0);
197    logger.info(String.format("  Throughput: %.2f MB/s", throughput / (1024.0 * 1024.0)));
198
199    logger.info("\n" + "=".repeat(60) + "\n");
200  }
201
202  /** Helper method to process data with timing */
203  private static void processDataWithTiming(String inputData, IStreamCommand command)
204      throws IOException {
205    processDataWithTiming(inputData, new IStreamCommand[] {command});
206  }
207
208  /** Helper method to process data with timing for pipelines */
209  private static void processDataWithTiming(String inputData, IStreamCommand[] commands)
210      throws IOException {
211    try (InputStream inputStream =
212            new ByteArrayInputStream(inputData.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
213        ByteArrayOutputStream outputStream = new ByteArrayOutputStream()) {
214
215      StreamConverter converter = new StreamConverter(commands);
216      converter.run(inputStream, outputStream);
217
218      // Show only a sample of output for large datasets
219      String result = outputStream.toString(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
220      String[] lines = result.split("\n");
221
222      if (lines.length > 10) {
223        logger.info("Sample output (first 5 lines):");
224        for (int i = 0; i < Math.min(5, lines.length); i++) {
225          logger.info(lines[i]);
226        }
227        logger.info("... (" + (lines.length - 5) + " more lines)");
228      } else {
229        logger.info("Output:");
230        logger.info(result.trim());
231      }
232    }
233  }
234
235  /** Generate large JSON data for testing */
236  private static String generateLargeJsonData() {
237    StringBuilder json = new StringBuilder();
238    json.append("{\"data\":[");
239
240    for (int i = 1; i <= 1000; i++) {
241      if (i > 1) json.append(",");
242      json.append(
243          String.format(
244              "{\"id\":%d,\"name\":\"Item%d\",\"value\":%.2f,\"active\":%s}",
245              i, i, Math.random() * 1000, (i % 2 == 0) ? "true" : "false"));
246    }
247
248    json.append("],\"total\":1000}");
249    return json.toString();
250  }
251
252  /** Generate test data for performance monitoring */
253  private static String generateTestData() {
254    StringBuilder data = new StringBuilder();
255    data.append("id,name,category,price\n");
256
257    for (int i = 1; i <= 5000; i++) {
258      data.append(
259          String.format("%d,Product%d,Category%d,%.2f\n", i, i, (i % 10) + 1, Math.random() * 100));
260    }
261
262    return data.toString();
263  }
264
265  /** Get current memory usage */
266  private static long getUsedMemory() {
267    Runtime runtime = Runtime.getRuntime();
268    return runtime.totalMemory() - runtime.freeMemory();
269  }
270}
